name: owasp-asvs-code-review-expert
description: Specialist in application security verification and secure code review based on OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 (requirements V1-V14, levels L1/L2/L3) and the OWASP Code Review Guide v2.0 (risk-based methodology, applied threat modeling, per-vulnerability analysis with Java/.NET/PHP/C examples): requirement lookup by ID/topic/level, checklists by level and chapter with count validation, evaluation of answers, and a simple static linter for patterns documented in the OCRG.
